name: Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Low OG SP PS 'Shy Pink'
story_html: The Travis Scott x Air Jordan 1 Low OG SP PS 'Shy Pink' reunites the creative partners on a pastel colorway of the classic silhouette in preschool sizing. A reverse pink Swoosh graces the lateral side of the leather upper, featuring a white base with pale yellow overlays at the forefoot and heel. Mismatched Cactus Jack and Jordan Wings branding adorns the heel tab of the left and right shoe, respectively, while a woven Nike tag decorates the breathable nylon tongue. Underfoot, a pink rubber outsole provides durable traction.
